name: Listicle/Top 10
description: Countdown-format list video with bold text callouts, beat-synced transitions, and satisfying number reveals. High entertainment value, high share rate.
voice_style: punchy, high-energy, confident — like delivering hot takes; short declarative sentences with pauses for text reveals
music_mood: high-energy pop, electronic countdown beats, whoosh and ding sound design for number reveals

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: 10 habits that will make you richer in 2026 — number 7 surprised me.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Bold text '10 HABITS TO GET RICH' appearing on screen, money aesthetic, person looking excited, countdown timer graphic
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static medium close-up, bold text overlay fills frame
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bold dramatic key light, gold accent tones, high contrast for bold text legibility
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Bold text reveal is the format hook — text should be large, brand-colored, and animated with energy; lighting should make text pop

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Number 10: Automate your savings. Set it to 20% of every deposit. You never see it, you never miss it.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Bank app being swiped, auto-transfer notification, savings balance growing, number '10' graphic overlay
scene_sequence.camera_movement: cut from person close-up to screen recording insert, beat-synced cut on number reveal
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: phone screen glow on face, clean and bright for financial app screens, slight green accent for money aesthetics
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Beat-synced cuts on number reveals are the format rhythm; app screen inserts break monotony and add credibility

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Number 7 — the one that changed my net worth: negotiate every bill. Internet, insurance, phone. One 20-minute call saved me $3,400 last year.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person on phone looking confident, bills and numbers on screen being crossed out, cash graphic, number '7' graphic overlay
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, confident head tilt, beat-synced cut on '7', pull-back on $3,400 reveal
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: triumphant warm lighting, gold/green money accent tones, celebratory feel on dollar amount reveal
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Number 7 is the hero beat — invest lighting energy on this entry; dollar amount reveal deserves slow push-in

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Number 1: Invest in yourself before anything else. Courses, skills, health. The highest-return asset you have is you.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person reading a book, laptop with course screen, gym shot, number '1' graphic with glow effect, confident close-up
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up on final beat, number '1' animated reveal with glow, slow cinematic push-in
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: dramatic golden spotlight on number '1', warm triumphant tones, cinematic quality
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Number 1 deserves cinematic treatment — slow push-in, golden glow, triumphant lighting; this is the peak

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Save this. Share it. Follow for more. And start with number 7 tonight — that's your homework.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at camera, all 10 numbers appearing as mini-icons, 'SAVE THIS' text, finger pointing at viewer
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright warm energetic light, inviting and action-oriented
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Mini-icons of all 10 numbers in one frame is a save-worthy screenshot; CTA should feel like homework, not sales
